conditions: Positive integer n; constant multiplier r; zeroth power interpreted as one.
spoken_aliases: a sub n equals a sub one times r raised to the power of open parenthesis n minus one close parenthesis
a sub n equals a sub 1 times r to the power of the quantity n minus 1 end exponent

evidence: Induction: at n=1 the zeroth power gives a_1. Multiply a_1 r^(n-1) by r to obtain a_1 r^n at the next index. This also covers r=0 with the declared zeroth-power convention.

Reference cross-check of the standard identity: https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/11-key-equations. Checked 2026-11-27. Approval is a maintainer review candidate, not independent human certification.
